name: Warm Pear, Walnut & Blue Cheese Toasts with Honey
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).
Place bread slices on the baking sheet. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, 2-3 minutes, or until toasted. Remove toast from the oven and set aside. (Keep the broiler on.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts and transfer to a medium bowl.
Add blue cheese to the bowl with the walnuts.
Wash, core, and medium dice the pears; transfer to the bowl with the walnuts and stir to combine.
Top each piece of toast with equal portions of walnut mixture.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until walnuts are toasted and the cheese becomes bubbly, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, divide toasts between dishes, drizzle with honey, and enjoy!
author: Mealime
